field_sources.strain: derived from saved displacement at original GP
field_sources.pore: original GP hydrostatic formula and VTU readback
field_sources.reaction: internal minus applied nodal load, reconstructed from saved effective stress/contact + exact hydrostatic force, including free residual as in the reference; projected support sum checked against saved native reaction

water_transition_scope: This unchanged cycle has fixed H=.75 and CONTINUOUS pressure=2.5 throughout all boundary stages and restarts; it contains no changing-water/flow/excavation stage. Existing regression tests are separate evidence, not an independent 3D certificate for those paths.

numerical_dissipation.definition: dw = q_end dot (closed_fraction * delta_jump); nd = dw - delta_elastic_energy - plastic_dissipation; accumulate max(nd,0) for every contact subsegment
numerical_dissipation.interpretation: Approximately 100% relative differences may occur as this partition error halves toward zero. This does not certify any other contact history.
